fusions.name: Ambush Lunge
fusions.desc: Springs 6 tiles from cover onto the target, dealing 14 damage and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Darting Snap
fusions.desc: Lunges at an enemy for 4 damage, up to 1.8 times as much at its maximum range.

fusions.name: Slip Past
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 10% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Light Footwork
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
